## 1. Slider redraws a figure

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof k = Inputs.range([0, 20], {step: 1, value: 7, label: "heads k"})
viewof n = Inputs.range([1, 20], {step: 1, value: 10, label: "flips n"})
```

```{pyodide}
#| edit: false
#| echo: false
#| input:
#|   - k
#|   - n
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

k_ = min(int(k), int(n))  # keep k <= n
a, b = 2 + k_, 2 + int(n) - k_   # Beta(2, 2) prior updated with the data
x = np.linspace(0, 1, 400)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 3))
ax.plot(x, stats.beta.pdf(x, 2, 2), "--", label="prior Beta(2, 2)")
ax.plot(x, stats.beta.pdf(x, a, b), label=f"posterior Beta({a}, {b})")
ax.set_xlabel("θ (probability of heads)")
ax.legend()
plt.show()
```

## 3. Graded exercise

Prior $\text{Beta}(2, 2)$, you observe $k = 7$ heads in $n = 10$ flips.
Fill in the posterior parameters $(\alpha', \beta')$.

```{pyodide}
#| exercise: ex_spike
alpha_post = 2 + ______
beta_post = 2 + ______
(alpha_post, beta_post)
```

```{pyodide}
#| exercise: ex_spike
#| check: true
import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from bayes.checks import check_posterior_params
ok, msg = check_posterior_params(result, alpha=2, beta=2, k=7, n=10)
feedback = {"correct": ok, "message": msg}
feedback
```

::: { .hint exercise="ex_spike" }
::: { .callout-note collapse="false" }
Heads add to α, tails add to β.
:::
:::

::: { .solution exercise="ex_spike" }
::: { .callout-tip collapse="false" }
```python
alpha_post = 2 + 7
beta_post = 2 + 3
(alpha_post, beta_post)
```
